description:
## Return YouTube Username v2.2.8

- Fix Video Subtitle Separation: Added proper spacing between channel names and view counts / metadata beneath the video player, preventing text sticking together.
- Support Video Subtitle In-text Handles: Handles appearing within compound video metadata lines now correctly resolve with uniform spacing.
- Pure Standalone Morphe Patch Bundle (~21 KB): Fully compatible with Morphe 2.1.0+ and YouTube 21.30.216.
